$comment: Provenance for every package this bundle ships. `origin` decides who owns the code: `ours` is written here, `adapted` is a fork of somebody else's work with local changes, `vendored` is copied with no local edits. `upstream` is the canonical source when there is one. `sync` names the directory a local checkout should match, which is what `dsh-everything doctor` compares against to catch drift. Keep this file honest: doctor reports what it finds, and a package whose `sync` target has diverged is a warning, not a silent fact. A syncRepo path is resolved relative to $DSH_EVERYTHING_SOURCES when that is set, so a checkout can live anywhere; without it the check is skipped rather than warned, because a machine that never authored these packages has nothing to compare.
